== Description ==

[[Daniel Amor]] (front left, green hoodie) playing an opponent in a tan cap and black hoodie (unlabeled, back to camera) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025, with [[Anthony Howard]] (background table, black "Return to Tradition" T-shirt and Dodgers cap on the table); remaining faces unlabeled.
